onlyChangedField: requires: replace f85 by4bdb; existing other prerequisites retained
reasoning: The current b8d atom requires explaining aromatic reactivity from electron delocalization. Its current full P profile requires benzene/alkene addition-versus-substitution reasoning, temporary sigma-complex loss and restoration of aromaticity, correct stoichiometry and explicit reaction-condition limits. It contains no diatomic MO-energy ordering, O2/N2 orbital occupancy or quantitative bond-order demand.

The full f85 atom requires interpreting simple molecular-orbital energy diagrams and deriving bond order. Those quantitative diatomic operations neither identify the aromatic cyclic conjugated pi system nor explain restoration of that system after electrophilic attack. Mastering them is not logically or didactically indispensable for the current qualitative b8d demand.

The complete current4bdb atom supplies exactly the delocalized pi system and special benzene stability through resonance. Combined with retained reaction-comparison prerequisites and explanations during the unchanged b8d task, it supports the full b8d demand; it is not a shortened replacement of either scientific goal.

RP gives an operative curricular counterexample: full original PDF54 has Aromaten I8.3 compulsory for LK with resonance/delocalization, addition-versus-substitution and mechanisms; full original PDF56 has MO theory in a separate optional LK8.7 module. Making full f85 mastery a universal gate adds a mandatory dependency the official route does not require.

BY LB4 genuinely prescribes simple MO schemes and LB5 aromatic orbital/delocalization reasoning, but sequencing those sections does not make complete O2/N2/bond-order performance a universal prerequisite for every aromatic-reactivity explanation. The complete extended-orbital/energy operator remains in f0 and other retained partners; this CAS does not erase it.

HE/HH/NI describe the aromatic resonance/reactivity route without a full diatomic-MO/bond-order operation; SN explicitly distinguishes atomic-energy configuration and the valence-bond/hybridization model from its aromatic pi-delocalization operation; SL prerequisite MO wording refers to overlap/orbital images and hybridization, not a supplied bonding/antibonding diatomic energy-level-and-bond-order task. ST retains a broad structure/reaction mechanism obligation, not a new quantitative MO prerequisite.
